claim_boundary: Fifty-four real fencing frames from seven YouTube source videos with 102 person and 1,442 2D keypoint annotations. Explicit source titles identify 4 epee, 3 foil, and 26 sabre frames; the remaining 21 stay weapon-unknown. MPII permits the annotations and code for research but states that it does not own the source-image copyright, so images and image-derived artifacts remain local research inputs and are not redistributed. Frames are not independent athlete or bout samples.
grouping_rule: hold out all frames from the same source_group_id together
